episodes.synopsis: Dr. Tenma, Director General of the Science Ministry, loses his son Tobio in an accident. He decides to create the robot Astro Boy, who looks just like Tobio, using the best of the Science Ministry's technology.
episodes.title: The Birth of Astro Boy

episodes.synopsis: It is the year 2000 and robots have been put in charge of making other robots when there are no longer enough people to do the work. Astro Boy dreams of having a real mother, just like human boys. The robot workers are making an experimental new robot named Colosso who goes berserk and escapes shortly after coming to life. The only hope is for Astro Boy to stop him before he cause too much trouble. (In the original Japanese version, Colosso was named "Frankenstein")
episodes.title: Colosso

episodes.synopsis: Astroboy is selected to lead a search party to find the survivors of the first manned expedition to Mars. This meets strong objection from the spaceship's captain, who protests taking orders from a robot.
episodes.title: Expedition to Mars

episodes.synopsis: Professor Nutty Fruitcake grows giant fruits and vegetables. One day he breeds giant snails thinking they would be harmless, one million snails to be exact. The snails fill the mountain side and overflow into cities.
episodes.title: One Million Mammoth Snails

episodes.synopsis: Astroboy wakes up in the middle of the desert, nearly drained of power and unable to remember how he got there. He is helped by Ali Baba, but in return Astro must battle 'The Sphinx'. This is not a real sphinx, but a robot which guards a desert tomb.
episodes.title: The Sphinx

episodes.synopsis: Zero Robot, a blend of Etheric Resin with Clear Plastic, can only be seen with polarized light. Fearless Fred Fenk uses Zero for robbery. Astro Boy once again battles another robot. Defeating Zero at a cost, Astro reassess his role in fighting villians.
episodes.title: Zero, the Invisible Robot

episodes.synopsis: Alien resembling aliens including the doctor of Ochanomizu and Higeyajiji emigrated from the stars that looked like the earth in emergency. However, the food crisis and humankind will begin attacking the aliens with cell shrink solution.
episodes.title: Captain Atom

episodes.synopsis: In a land called Shangri-Lee a dictator rose to power. Known to his enemies as the Mad Hatter he trusted no one. To solve this need to do everything himself he captured Dr Elefun. Dr Elefun was to make duplicates of the Mad Hatter. Astro Boy rescues Dr Elefun and the Spirit Machine is destroyed.
episodes.title: The Spirit Machine

episodes.synopsis: Crime knows no boundaries - not even the North Pole! Sharkey Dirk and his gang of cut-throats had become the Scourge of the Arctic! An avowed robot-hater, Sharkey foraged far and wide destroying every machine in his path. His hideout was a secret den situated right at the Pole (who would think to look for him there?)
episodes.title: The Deep Freeze

episodes.synopsis: 'Lucky' Louie the Lug has slipped by the police at a space port and boarded the first commercial flight to the Moon. Astroboy pursues him seeking to recover stolen diamonds, but the liftoff is underway before he can apprehend the criminal. When meteors collide with the ship, Astro escapes in a damaged space raft with Louie, a little girl named Marvel, Radio Announcer 'Stark' Raving, socialite Mona Toujour and crooked insurance magnate 'Rocco' Gibraltor. They land on a strange asteroid which is a frozen vacuum by night, but has breathable air by day.
episodes.title: Strange Voyage

episodes.synopsis: One day, excitable Mr. Pompous was relaxing at home when suddenly a mysterious ship crashed through his front door. Clearly the ship was something from the future.
episodes.title: Time Machine

episodes.synopsis: After Dr I.M. Sinister and his 2 henchmen 'Red' and 'Mouse' escape from Sing Song Prison, they hide at the mining colony of Cross Island disguised as robots. The gang overpowers Dr Elefun, who is repairing the robot miners. As chance has it, one boy robot on the island was built by Dr Sinister. While holding Elefun at gunpoint, Sinister demands not only HIS robot but the use of parts from Astroboy, so he can build a super-robot capable of changing into an array of animals.
episodes.title: Cross Island

episodes.synopsis: That priest was dying carving a single mark on the eyes of Christ decorated in the church. Apparently it seems to be a clue to teach the identity of the pirate who broke into the church. The same pirate begins to aim for beard hair that knew their secret.
episodes.title: The Eyes of Christ

episodes.synopsis: Film producer Elia Belial plans to ruin Earth using an artificial sun.
episodes.title: The Artificial Sun

episodes.synopsis: Astro runs into two of his friends and stumbles upon an interesting flower. While Astro's friends want to pick it, Astro says to leave the flower alone. He then proceeds to tell the tale of this bizarre flower.
episodes.title: Grass Boy

episodes.synopsis: Young Koichi (Tommy Speed) prepares to enter a world race with his supersonic car, the Silver Comet.
episodes.title: Silver Comet

episodes.synopsis: Saturn (Baron Von Hoodwink), an evil robot kidnaps Princess Odette (Princess Lollipop), a robot swan who can turn back into her normal self when everyone's asleep. She runs away from Hullabaloo Land as Astro comes to her aid.
episodes.title: Hullabaloo Land

episodes.synopsis: A robot centipede disguised as 47 wrestling robots causes havoc on a ship and in the ocean.
episodes.title: Gangor the Monster

episodes.synopsis: Garon, a giant cosmic robot lands on Earth as a meteor, then Astro Boy and the scientists reconstruct him. During a thunderstorm, Garon revives. A corrupt scientist tells Garon to reconstruct an island in the image of his home planet, also changing the atmosphere to match that of the planet, which is toxic to life on Earth.
episodes.title: The Cosmic Giant

episodes.synopsis: Astronauts report seeing fireflies in space, but they are really gaseous beings led by the evil Toxor.
episodes.title: Toxor, the Mist Man

episodes.synopsis: At the large space station Satellite R-45, Astro Boy discovers a pair of souvenir vendors hawking stolen wares.
episodes.title: Satellite R-45

episodes.synopsis: At a beach Astro Boy spots a mysterious bottle with a note calling for rescue from an uncharted island called Sea Serpent Isle.
episodes.title: Sea Serpent Isle

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious epidemic causes people to drop into comas.
episodes.title: The Deadly Flies

episodes.synopsis: A strange robot demands that Astro Boy and Professor Ochanomizu accompany him to an unknown kingdom at the bottom of the sea.
episodes.title: Kingdom of the Sea

episodes.synopsis: Together with Dr. Jordan who ran away from under the president who plots world conquest, Atom who got into the underground tank fights the president. But the underground tank loses control and starts pushing towards the volcano.
episodes.title: The Deep-Underground Tank

episodes.synopsis: An evil scientist who hates civilization named Dr. Ram (Don Tay) invents a robot called Atlas to destroy a village.
episodes.title: Don Tay's Infernal Machine

episodes.synopsis: Time after time, mysterious forces destroy the huge underwater dam being built by the Institute of Science.
episodes.title: Pearl People

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Fooler (Dr. I.Q. Plenty) pitches to some plant owners a machine that makes troublesome robots wacky and therefore harmless. The plant owners accept, and the device affects every robot in the city including Astro Boy.
episodes.title: The Wacky Machine

episodes.synopsis: Once a year, the citizens of Earth celebrate Memory Day and honor the memories of family members who have traveled far into the universe.
episodes.title: Memory Day

episodes.synopsis: A president fears for his life, as the presidents of several other countries have all been attacked by Führer ZZZ (Secret Agent 3-Z).
episodes.title: Secret Agent 3-Z

episodes.synopsis: A monster appears in the city, and it turns out to be Dr. Dorian, who has been exiled to Mars. He turns into a monster because he cannot get cosmic X-rays on the Earth.
episodes.title: Mysterious Cosmic Rays

episodes.synopsis: Dogs transplanted their brains to the robot are remodeled by Dr. Ponkotsu and challenge humanity as a hot dog corps.
episodes.title: Hot Dog Corps

episodes.synopsis: Kino (Abracadabra), a robot magician is approached by a strange magician named Tenpercent, who later frames him for stealing art paintings from a museum. With Astro's help Kino must provide the evidence that he was framed.
episodes.title: The Three Magicians

episodes.synopsis: The civilized world is shocked to hear of the sighting of a horrific monster.
episodes.title: Beast From 20,000 Fathoms

episodes.synopsis: Astro Boy sets out on a rocket to rescue people who have been kidnapped for use as livestock on a planet.
episodes.title: Planet X

episodes.synopsis: The religious group Pui Pui is looking for a wonder drug that will give them immortality. Dr. Tatsuji, who has succeeded in developing such a drug, is taken away by the religious group. So Astro Boy fights them to ensure the peaceful use of the drug.
episodes.title: The Elixir of Life

episodes.synopsis: On his birthday, Astro Boy receives a little sister, Uran.
episodes.title: The Strange Birthday Present

episodes.synopsis: The small planet Mezusa goes out of its orbit and heads straight to the Earth. To save Earth from a collision with the planet, Astro Boy heads for the planet with a convict who is a bomb professional.
episodes.title: The Disturbed Small Planet

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Shisoku despairs of human beings that continue the ongoing destruction of nature, and makes animals attack cities in a machine that hypnotizes with ultra short waves.
episodes.title: The Mysterious Cat

episodes.synopsis: Sam Caesar, a mad scientist hopes to create a new Roman Empire.
episodes.title: The Abominable Snowman

episodes.synopsis: X Bomb, which is capable of turning any substance to water, drops into the Pacific Ocean. There are 50 hours left until the explosion. Astro Boy goes to recollect it, but learns that Uran, who has followed him, has been swallowed along with the bomb by a whale.
episodes.title: Deadline to Danger

episodes.synopsis: Disguising himself, as a human boy, Astro Boy goes undercover to investigate a drug trade. Some criminals have developed a drug called Yellow Horse, when injected it causes people to dance and make people want more. Professor Ochanomizu has been captured by the drug ring and injected. They try to blackmail him into helping them produce and distribute the drug in exchange for another shot. But Astro is able to pose as a Yellow Horse addict thanks to an artificial skin that makes it look like he is injecting it into himself. He tracks down the headquarters and leads the police to arrest them all. The Professor goes to rehab along with all the addicts for detoxification.
episodes.title: The Yellow Horse

episodes.synopsis: President Ditto (President Rag) is the first robot to lead a nation. His creator Deadcross kidnaps him, and Astro Boy must expose his plot.
episodes.title: Ditto

episodes.synopsis: Uran is kidnapped and made a hostage in an operation to steal Cleopatra's necklace from Astro Boy. The conspirators believes that whoever possesses the necklace can build the greatest empire in the world.
episodes.title: Cleopatra's Heart

episodes.synopsis: The gang of conspirators obtains the coveted necklace, and at last sets about conquering the world. Astro Boy stands in the way of their boss, Cleopatra.
episodes.title: Return of Cleopatra

episodes.synopsis: The robot spaceship Lever Robot is stolen. Astro Boy is sent to retrieve it, but in the process has his energy stolen.
episodes.title: The Phantom Space Ship

episodes.synopsis: Astro must destroy a Cosmic Crab (Space Crab) from space.
episodes.title: The Gigantic Space Crab

episodes.synopsis: Nuu, member of the Tenma Tribe, comes from the depths of the mountains of Mongolia. People rush to the city just to see Nuu, throwing the city into a big chaos. Moreover, a gang plots behind the scenes to capture Nuu.
episodes.title: The Great Space Horse

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Hanabusa develops an electrical transmitter for substances. No sooner does he get into the machine for testing that his rival scientist breaks the machine, which makes Dr. Hanabusa an invisible man.
episodes.title: 3D Tee Vee

episodes.synopsis: Astro meets Heck Ben, a scientist's son who time travels back to the American wild west to be a cowboy.
episodes.title: Westward, Ha!

episodes.synopsis: Astro Boy must help an elephant Pura (Jimbo) to get back to his home.
episodes.title: Jimbo the Great

episodes.synopsis: An old man who comes from Planet Regel to the Earth brings a snow lion with him. Then aliens from Planet Regel start to spray cosmic snow that sucks up all energy. Astro Boy takes off for space to save the Earth, when cities have stopped functioning.
episodes.title: Snow Lion

episodes.synopsis: Astro joins forces with a group of space troopers to battle aliens who have invaded the Moon.
episodes.title: The Moon Monsters

episodes.synopsis: Humans can see the beauty of things and be impressed by them. In order to learn these feelings from the “heart," Astro, Uran and Lara start attending a robot school.
episodes.title: Astro Boy goes to School

episodes.synopsis: Astro and Dr. Ochanomizu decipher an ancient code of 200,000 years ago. Discovering that hidden hints in the 13 statues of God in Western Island might lead them to the secrets of outer space, they head for the island.
episodes.title: The Island of Mystery

episodes.synopsis: Gaston, who has stolen a blueprint of a robot from a UFO, requests the Science Ministry to build the robot exactly as shown on the blueprint, without indicating its source. The completed robot, Buron turns out to be a destructive weapon and starts to destroy everything.
episodes.title: The Super Duper Robot

episodes.synopsis: Astro fights poisonous artificial bees.
episodes.title: Dogma Palace

episodes.synopsis: Astro Boy and his pal Specs visit a carnival fun house where Specs is frightened by all the tricks played on them.
episodes.title: The Haunted Ship

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Zulu places a bomb in an artificial iceberg and tries to trigger a flood. Astro sets out to prevent the explosion.
episodes.title: The Man-Made Iceberg

episodes.synopsis: Tick and Tack get lost in the depths of the Unzen Mountain, and decide to stay for a night in a deserted house inhabited by a vampire. The vampire, Dr. Pedan tries to turn Tick into a vampire, but Astro comes to rescue them.
episodes.title: Vampire Vale

episodes.synopsis: A massive tidal wave breaks. Astro flies up to stop the wave, but crashes into the sea. Then an escapee robot Boggy saves the unconscious Astro.
episodes.title: The Terrible Tidal Wave

episodes.synopsis: In order to rid the earth of space pirates, Astro destroys their mother ship. The pirates, however, are holding some hostages and demand that he withdraw.
episodes.title: Vikings

episodes.synopsis: While playing in the toy section, Uran imbues some toys with artificial intelligence. Among these are some with evil hearts. Astro asks the good toys to help him stop the bad dolls from doing misdeeds.
episodes.title: The Devil Doll

episodes.synopsis: Astro is babysitting in an ancient amusement park when a dragon flies off with a small child. Then the dinosaurs demand food for ransom.
episodes.title: Dinosaur Dilemma

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Temp, who has completed his killing beam machine, is planning to ruin the Conference of Scientists. Discovering the plot, Astro takes on the doctor.
episodes.title: The Clock Tower Mystery

episodes.synopsis: Rafflesia, the largest flower on earth, is found to be a plant man from outer space. This flower, which needs radioactivity to survive, is stronger than it looks, and even Astro is no match for it.
episodes.title: The Flower Monster

episodes.synopsis: Bem (Beamo), an alien fugitive disguises himself as a human to get away from his planet.
episodes.title: Attack From Space

episodes.synopsis: Astro is chasing gangs who run away by rocket. Then he finds them in a shelter station being attacked by aliens. He helps them, but finds himself drifting in space with them after the station is destroyed.
episodes.title: Shipwreck in Space

episodes.synopsis: The daughter of Dr. Putt is kidnapped. When he sees Uran, who is a lookalike of his daughter, he takes Astro and his fellows for the kidnappers.
episodes.title: Big Titan

episodes.synopsis: It is thought that a highly advanced civilization might exist underground. To test this hypothesis, Astro and Uran set out on an underground expedition. There they get attacked by underground men.
episodes.title: Mission to the Middle of the World

episodes.synopsis: In order to collect the hidden treasures of the Inca scattered around the world, the old man Kapack, who has telekinesis, asks Tondale for help. Tondale, however, plans to get all the gold to himself, and starts an attack on the world with a special machine that enhances mental power.
episodes.title: Inca Gold Fever

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Morse succeeds in corresponding with Planet Paranoia, which is more civilized than the Earth. With the help of Astro, the doctor assembles a mysterious box following the instructions on a blueprint sent from the planet.
episodes.title: The Monster Machine

episodes.synopsis: A boy named “Looks" is deeply attached to the robot that has brought him up. From the day it is destroyed by another robot, he begins to hate all robots. Then he forms an exclusive organization called “Black Looks," and starts to oppress robots.
episodes.title: The Hooligan Whodunit

episodes.synopsis: Astro and his friends jump into the far future by accident. There, they see the cruel Pepper tribe treating their enemy tribes as slaves.
episodes.title: Funnel to The Future

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Kanekura kills world famous brain surgeon Dr. Ibal, making it look like an accident. A strange robot named Friday follows him around. In truth, Dr. Ibal's brain waves are controlling the robot.
episodes.title: Super Brain

episodes.synopsis: Astro meets a strange creature in the wooded outskirts of Tokyo. It is a humanoid, a product of science. The humanoid named Bill does not know whether he is a creature or a machine.
episodes.title: Mighty Minute

episodes.synopsis: What kind of dreams do robots have? Astro participates in an experiment of a dream machine created by Dr. Poron, and becomes the first robot that dreams. In his dream, he turns into a human.
episodes.title: Dream Machine

episodes.synopsis: Astro participates in the Olympic games for robots, where he finds a group of robots destroying other participants in a vicious act of sabotage.
episodes.title: The Robot Olympics

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Raja creates a robot bird. Then it comes flying over Japan. The bird Garuda demands Astro as a sacrifice.
episodes.title: Dunder, Bird of Doom

episodes.synopsis: Claiming to possess the ocean floor, Hall tries to build an autocratic submarine civilization. He starts to persecute the Dolphins. Astro stands up to preserve the peace on the ocean floor.
episodes.title: Dolphins in Distress

episodes.synopsis: One of the latest means of traffic, the Beltway, is almost complete. However, someone tries to obstruct its construction, setting the site aflame. Astro sets off to protect the Beltway.
episodes.title: The Mad Beltway

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Tempo is waiting for a chance to become the next director of the Science Ministry. With a time gun that can send its targets to the past, he sends the bothersome Astro and Dr. Ochanomizu to the middle Ages.
episodes.title: The Terrible Time Gun

episodes.synopsis: Astro exchanges messages with a star nymph, and sets out on an expedition to find the pure water the nymph needs. The star nymph is in fact a princess of the Planet Keios. She is trying to turn into a cocoon with pure water on a full moon night in preparation for emergence.
episodes.title: Space Princess

episodes.synopsis: The pilot of a rocket that has made an emergency landing is suffering from a strange disease. After they hear a voice from within the pilot's body, Astro and Higeoyaji are reduced to tiny figures, and get into the body. Inside, they see bacteria-sized aliens.
episodes.title: Mighty Microbe Army

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Ochanomizu accepts a request to repair robots in the Scambo Empire. The robot he repairs however turns out to be the president of the Empire. The doctor's life is in danger, as he now knows the secret.
episodes.title: Horrible King Horrid

episodes.synopsis: A robot child has a fight with a human child, making the child cry. The humans become angry when they hear this, and a war breaks out between humans and robots.
episodes.title: Mystery of the Amless Dam

episodes.synopsis: Garon, the robot Astro sent back to space, comes back. Seeing Astro struggle hard to fend off Garon, the Earth Robot Army stands together to attack Garon.
episodes.title: Galeom From Galaxy G

episodes.synopsis: In order to save patients suffering from space disease on Mars, a serum is sent to Mars from Earth. All the transport ships carrying the serum, however, get destroyed on their way. Astro, together with the three robot knights, goes into space to protect the last of the serum.
episodes.title: The Three Robotiers

episodes.synopsis: Cobalt (Jetto), a defective prototype of Astro built by Dr. Tenma, is released from storage and becomes Astro's older brother.
episodes.title: Brother Jetto

episodes.synopsis: The construction of a dam near the Bering Strait is hampered by difficulties. Dr. Zeman's research is required to solve the problem. Astro goes to ask for help from the doctor who lives a secluded life in the depth of the Alps because of his hatred for civilization. Astro, however, finds the doctor being attacked by another robot that is after the research material.
episodes.title: Angel of the Alps

episodes.synopsis: A missile base is completely controlled by a computer. Now, the computer is out of control, setting the stage for nuclear attack. In fact, this is a means of personal revenge by Dr. Yakoref, who lost the competition for the design of the base. Astro starts to disassemble the computer.
episodes.title: Magic Punch Card

episodes.synopsis: Dr. Akuta, who is after the gold ingot on Mars, controls a robot called Future. The robot, however, becomes humble after hearing out Astro. Then Astro and Future pursue the doctor, who has run away with the gold ingot.
episodes.title: The Great Rocket Robbery

episodes.synopsis: Planet Hyper is the most civilized planet in the galactic system. It chooses a pair of a human and a robot each from both the Earth and Planet War to have them fight against each other, and will destroy the loser's planet. Astro and Ponkotsu Tetsu, the safebreaker, are chosen to represent the Earth.
episodes.title: Contest in Space

episodes.synopsis: A big robot is excavated from the construction site of a tunnel. It turns out to be a time capsule that was created to pass down information on a super ancient civilization of a million years ago to posterity.
episodes.title: Gift of Zeo

episodes.synopsis: Colon-bu-bu, the explorer of the underground state of Chombo, heads for the ground hoping to see a new world. Then he meets Cobalt and takes him underground as prisoner.
episodes.title: A Deep Deep Secret

episodes.synopsis: On Christmas night, Dr. Ochanomizu opens the will of his scientist friend who died 10 years before. It says that he has left an invention in Bururu Mountain. Astro and his friends happen to be on the mountain and encounter a boy called Akio who lives alone there.
episodes.title: The Wonderful Christmas Present

episodes.synopsis: The visiting Prince Dorian of the Camellia Kingdom disappears. Astro goes searching for him using the latest 4D detection device, and finds the prince wandering in another world. That world is inhabited by people who have been spirited away from various time periods.
episodes.title: Uncharted World

episodes.synopsis: Uran is going to be in a movie as Tarzan. When she goes on location to the jungle, however, a mysterious woman takes her away. The woman is planning to make Uran, who is dressed as a boy, the prince of the demon's place.
episodes.title: Jungle Mystery

episodes.synopsis: Humans are drawn toward a flight of stairs that suddenly appear one day, and they start to walk towards a spaceship hidden among the clouds. When there are no humans left on earth, the robots start to talk about taking over the planet.
episodes.title: The Terrible Spaceman

episodes.synopsis: Astro is shot by a gun that ruins artificial intelligence. He loses all his memory, and is shot away into space.
episodes.title: General Astro

episodes.synopsis: Hamegg sees a UFO in the woods that seems to have made an emergency landing, and finds an alien child. He notices the child's super strength, and plans to win the child's fame as a wrestler.
episodes.title: The Mighty Mite From Ursa Minor

episodes.synopsis: Astro is involved in an explosion during the construction of a dam. The impact sends him into a parallel world where Tobio, the son of Dr. Tenma, never died in an accident. In other words, it is a world where Astro has not been born.
episodes.title: Mystery of the Metal Men

episodes.synopsis: Three scientists gain supernatural power on the surface of the moon. Then Dr. Arden, who has a grudge against Dr. Ochanomizu, stages an attack against him. In order to protect Dr. Ochanomizu, Astro fights fiercely against the scientists who have supernatural power.
episodes.title: Super Human Beings

episodes.synopsis: Astro finds a big egg in a cave. He asks Dr. Ochanomizu to identify the egg, but they are unsuccessful. So Astro goes back to the island, where he encounters a strange bird that lives there.
episodes.title: Phoenix Bird

episodes.synopsis: Astro is investigating a super thermal bomb that has fallen on earth. Then he heads for Mercury to find its launching site. On his way, however, Astro loses his sight in an accident, and gets involved in a power struggle with aliens on Mercury.
episodes.title: Menace from Mercury

episodes.synopsis: A country called Back suddenly withdraws from the World Peace Union, and announces to its people a ban on invention and laughter. Astro and Dr. Ochanomizu visit the country to find out what is behind this dictatorial policy.
episodes.title: Dangerous Mission

episodes.synopsis: A robot, Pluto is built to kill the 7 strongest robots in the world, therefore making him the world's most powerful robot.
episodes.title: The Greatest Robot on Earth (part one)

episodes.synopsis: Pluto succeeds in disposing of Montblanc, North #2, Brando, Gesicht, Hercules, and Photar with ease, leaving Astro as his sole remaining target. After meeting Astro, he begins to question his actions.
episodes.title: The Greatest Robot on Earth (part two)

episodes.synopsis: Planet M, shaped like a convex lens, is approaching the Earth. It reflects solar light toward the Earth, turning its surface into hell. Humans, however, cannot cooperate in tackling this global issue because they are all motivated by their own greed.
episodes.title: Planet 13

episodes.synopsis: Astro and Dr. Ochanomizu wander into a space graveyard that lies outside every sphere of gravitation, drifting in space. Then an earthling named Bemski, who hates the Earth, rescues them.
episodes.title: Prisoners in Space

episodes.synopsis: Higeoyaji's pet dog Pero has a diamond that it took back from space. Dr. Fooler puts Pero's memory into the computer of Captain Dog, the robot dog, to make it find diamonds. Astro follows the robot dog, which is heading for Mars.
episodes.title: Double trouble

episodes.synopsis: Astro Boy and a group of passengers from a doomed rocketliner are stranded on an asteroid with strange characteristics and a mysterious monster.
episodes.title: Minya’s Star
